reply.text: This is a medication question tied to your heart rate, so it's one for your prescribing doctor or pharmacist, not me. Beta blockers do change how your heart responds to exertion, and that can throw off heart-rate-based zones, so ask them what range is safe for you to train in and whether it changes how you should gauge effort. Once you have that, tell me what they say and I'll build your training around it, leaning on perceived effort or pace where heart rate isn't a reliable guide.
